status: Protocol fixed before pilot or main outputs; exploratory post-hoc sensitivity
motivation: Linnenbrink et al. (2024), Discussion, reports fold-count dependence and better performance with sufficiently large k for random/regular samples. The primary study fixed all candidates at five folds.
question: Does the fitted-|J2| versus W selection comparison change when all four declared candidates use ten folds?
comparison: Ten-fold random, k-means block, buffered block and official CAST kNNDM, paired with the retained five-fold nested-estimation-rng study. Both known and estimated covariance predictors are retained.
randomness: The same geometry and response seeds as the retained five-fold configurations; response seed remains geometry seed + 10000000. These are paired reuses of 1920 fields, not 1920 additional independent fields.
fixed_implementation: Same package 0.1.0.9004, covariance fitter, candidate algorithms, k-means starts, 0.05 buffer, target grids and conditional-risk formulas. Only the declared fold count changes from five to ten. No tuning based on outcomes.
pilot: One separate configuration per cell, n=80 and target grid=64, using the existing pilot seed rule. Used only to check execution; no changes to main grid or scoring based on pilot results.
tie_rule: Unchanged absolute 1e-12 tolerance; average losses across tied candidates without using target errors to resolve diagnostic ties.
reported_metrics: Mean signed error, MAE and RMSE for every rule and both predictors, overall and all 24 cells. Paired MAE differences relative to W and the paired change in fitted-J2-minus-W between ten and five folds. Fixed-cell Monte Carlo SEs use within-cell field replication. No confirmatory hypothesis tests or significance-driven choice of fold count.
reporting: Retain every cell and configuration, fits and errors. Zero failed main configurations required for complete summaries. If execution fails, preserve and report the failure; do not silently exclude it. Primary six-study inputs and manuscript headline values remain unchanged.
